title: Bolder hand: choose the visual world
question: Bolder register. The deal leads with Night Flight Six-Pack; The Fight Poster beats it on both axes. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Night Flight Six-Pack
options.thesis: Preflight for tomorrow night: six calm gauges that all agree, and the master switch is yes.
options.viewport: Two rows of three dials fill the phone: T-minus to dinner counting down, heading pointing at the restaurant, 'how much I want this' pegged at the stop, table for 2, dress code, fuel (hungry). Placard caps under each. A guarded toggle at the bottom: ARM / YES.
options.risk: She is not a pilot; the joke has to land in the placards or it reads as a dashboard.

raised.raise: Yes lifts a lid: the details reveal in staged steps, never all at once.
Needles breathe with damped spring motion; nothing snaps.
Every quantity is tabular mono; 7:30 and 1/2 read as instrument values.

options.label: The Fight Poster
options.lineage: boxing fight poster, two names at a gold VS
options.thesis: JOSE vs HER NAME. Tomorrow night. One night only. The main event is dinner.
options.viewport: The sheet splits at a gold VS: his name fills the top half to the edge, hers the bottom, slab caps at collision scale. Under the mark: TOMORROW NIGHT, the venue, the time in letterpress smalls. The undercard shrinks line by line: appetizers, the wine list, dessert (contested), who pays (decided). Tickets: say yes.
options.case: Universally legible and funny between two people who are marrying; every product fact (names, date, place, time, the ask) has a native slot on the sheet. Wins both axes.
options.risk: The joke only works with real slab caps at full scale; timid type turns it into a wedding-site template.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: Four snaps, one flick apart: Tomorrow. Dinner. With me? Yes.
options.viewport: One word owns the screen; caption low left, heart on the right rail; the next snap is already loaded.
options.case: She holds this form every day, so identification is instant; loses on clarity because the form is anonymous and the details need a fifth snap.

options.label: Raku Smoke Flash
options.lineage: raku firing, crackled glaze from smoke
options.thesis: The invitation as a vessel lifted from the kiln.
options.viewport: An ember-orange bowl in smoke; the lid lifts on tap.
options.case: Beautiful but the ask has no native slot; she would have to guess.
options.kept: Staged reveal, one step at a time.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: carbon rods and red cord in tension
options.thesis: Two forces holding each other up.
options.viewport: A column that breathes; force labels on leader lines.
options.case: Lovely metaphor for a couple, zero legibility as an invitation.
options.risk: Needs a caption to explain itself.

options.label: Exposure Record Sheets
options.thesis: Translucent sheets over a zone ramp.
options.viewport: Ruled boxes of seconds under an enlarger glow.
options.case: A working field for a task; the invitation is not one.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The e-invitation everyone ships: cream, script headline, a soft floral, one rounded Yes button.
canonCard.viewport: Centered card, script 'Will you have dinner with me?', a pink Yes button.
